name: Symbiant Adaptation
body:
Prerequisites: Symbiant race, fire and sonic vulnerability racial trait.

Benefit: Your vulnerability to fire and sonic damage is reduced to 25%, and you only suffer a –2 penalty to non-damaging fire, light, and sonic effects.
